scope: Training only. No Valoria code/assets, no Windows reservation, no model weight changes. Read public documentation; course overview is not course completion. Video-only modules are references, not claimed watched.

sources.note: The course teaches directional/environment light, shadows, baked lighting and probes. For sprite production, translate light direction, ambient fill and shadows into controlled image tests rather than add URP lights blindly.

Material and shader properties control apparent surface behavior. The course uses a still-life exercise. Separate color, reflectivity and texture scale; prove distinguishable stone, wood and iron in identical lighting.
Choose a camera setup for the experience and test framing. Fix camera and resolution in A/B tests; avoid changing zoom as a confound.
Orthographic projection preserves apparent object size with distance and parallel edges. Orthographic Scale sets framing. Guides help assess the composition; no arbitrary perspective mismatch.

Principled BSDF separates base color, microfacet roughness and metallic behavior. Wood and stone are dielectrics; iron is metallic where exposed. Roughness modifies highlight spread; bump is small relief, not random color noise.
Area emitters create softer shadow boundaries as their apparent size grows. Distinguish key direction, fill intensity and light size. Preserve contact and coherent cast shadows.
PPU converts texture pixels to world units; custom pivot defines the local origin. Preserve canvas and alpha with a stable foot anchor when reauthoring. Check texture settings on target build.
Unity can sort 2D rendering by a custom axis and layer/order. Use the real project foot-based sort system and check crossing in motion; don't assume this manual replaces existing implementation.
The lesson identifies form, value and light as painting foundations. Study the public description; the embedded video is not assumed viewed. Practice form in grayscale before texture.
Use the indexed exercises on value, edges, shadow properties and material spheres as a syllabus. Do not claim to have watched videos from the list.

competencies.task: render matched still-life, intentional key/fill and shadow edges
render stone, wood, iron without modifying geometry
fixed orthographic projection, check PPU and pivot calculations
three-dimensional workshop layout with protected entrance, distinct hierarchy, mobile thumbnail and foot sorting

policy.source_notes: Paraphrased guidance verified by orchestrator; agents receive selected text of successfully retrieved pages, provenance and source notes. No hidden course access or certificates.
policy.reusable: Store reviewed technique cards, source links, applicability, failures, exercise evidence; no automatic promotion. Apply gate before game work.
policy.pass: Render compared against fresh control. Score within each exercise only. Report negative results; repeat on new holdouts before broad claims.
